note: The batching moved out of _write_multi and into _update_rows_sql, and took an arg-type error with it: `for sub_rows in batched(rows, UPDATE_BATCH_SIZE)` handed `_execute_update` a `tuple[tuple, ...]` where its signature says `list[tuple]`, at write.py:240. _write_multi now passes the whole group -- a real list -- and the batched() tuples go to the new _update_rows_values_sql, whose parameter is typed for both. 1072 -> 1071, measured the section 9.3 way: mypy 2.3.0 alone in a fresh venv, --no-incremental, over the six packages, in a worktree at HEAD with only this change applied. HEAD measured 1072 on the same run, so the gate was green before and the move is entirely this change.
